name: anamnesis
description: Persistent memory for Claude Code — deterministic capture via lifecycle hooks. Per-user encrypted, visible, deletable. 0.3.1 completes the OAuth 2.1 + PKCE + DCR migration: 'anamnesis-config' runs the browser consent flow, and hook auth uses Authorization: Bearer with automatic refresh-token rotation. Legacy X-Anamnesis-Key fallback kept for existing installs through the 2026-05-20 deprecation cutoff — re-run 'anamnesis-config' to upgrade.
